goal: Initialize the Master of Music project as a Vite + TypeScript + Vitest + ESLint + Prettier skeleton with a Canvas2D bootstrap that opens a 480x270 canvas scaled to fit the viewport with nearest-neighbor scaling. Establish the directory structure declared in docs/03-TECHNICAL_ARCHITECTURE.md section 3.
constraints: TypeScript 5.x strict mode (all strict flags on, including noUncheckedIndexedAccess).
Do not introduce a game framework (no Phaser, PixiJS, Excalibur).
Canvas2D only; imageSmoothingEnabled = false; integer-only positioning.
Renderer must keep aspect ratio 16:9 and use CSS letterboxing at non-16:9 viewports.
Vitest configured with jsdom environment and a stubbed CanvasRenderingContext2D for unit tests.
No external dependencies beyond: vite, vitest, typescript, eslint, @typescript-eslint/*, prettier, @types/node, jsdom.
acceptance: `npm run dev` opens a window showing a black 480x270 canvas centered with letterboxing.
`npm run test` exits 0 with at least 3 passing tests (renderer instantiation, scene-stack push/pop, title-scene enter).
`npm run build` produces dist/ with no errors.
verification: bash -c 'npm install --silent && npm run lint --silent && npm run typecheck --silent && npm run test --silent && npm run build --silent'
